method: Boil in tamarind water with turmeric and salt until cooked, then drain.
For each part, mix 2 spoons of gram flour, 1 spoon of chili powder, 1/2 spoon of table salt, a little curry leaves, and a little hing.
Mix them without mashing the bitter gourd.
This will be like a light powder coating on the vegetable.
Fry each part in boiling oil like you fry pakodas.
The bitter gourd roast will be very crunchy. It won't be bitter.
